description_sq:
Toke per shitje ne Farke.
Siperfaqja 1500 m2.
Toke e verdhe me dokumentacion te rregullt.
Prona ndodhet ne nje zone ne zhvillim te vazhdueshem, e rrethuar nga investime prestigjoze kompleksesh vilash, gje qe e ben shume te pershtatshme per ndertim rezidencial, vila private apo investim afatgjate.
Zona ofron qetesi, privatesi dhe potencial te larte zhvillimi, me akses te mire rrugor dhe kerkese ne rritje.
description_en: Land for sale in Farke. Surface 1500 m2. Yellow land with proper documentation. The property is located in an area in continuous development, surrounded by prestigious investments of villa complexes, which makes it very suitable for residential construction, private villas or long-term investment. The area offers tranquility, privacy and high development potential, with good road access and growing demand.
